en.t: Roman emperor Caracalla is assassinated and is succeeded by his Praetorian Guard prefect, Marcus Opellius Macrinus
en.s: The Roman emperor was the ruler of the Roman Empire, starting with the granting of the title augustus to Octavian in 27 BC. The title of imperator, originally a military honorific, was usually used alongside caesar, originally a cognomen. When a given Roman is described as becoming emperor in English, it generally reflects his accession as augustus, and later as basileus.

zh.t: 罗马皇帝卡拉卡拉遇刺，其禁卫军长官马尔库斯·奥佩利乌斯·马克里努斯继位
zh.s: 罗马皇帝是罗马帝国的统治者，这一称号始于公元前27年屋大维获授“奥古斯都”头衔。Imperator原本是军事荣誉称号，通常与原为姓氏的Caesar一同使用。英文资料称某位罗马人成为皇帝，通常指他即位为奥古斯都，后世则称巴西琉斯。

en.t: Roman emperor Caracalla (pictured) was assassinated near Harran and succeeded by his Praetorian Guard prefect Macrinus
en.s: Marcus Aurelius Antoninus (born Lucius Septimius Bassianus, 4 April 188 – 8 April 217), better known by his nickname Caracalla (; Latin: [karaˈkalːa]), was Roman emperor from 198 to 217 AD, first serving as nominal co-emperor under his father and then ruling alone after 211 AD. He was a member of the Severan dynasty, the elder son of Emperor Septimius Severus and Empress Julia Domna.

zh.t: 罗马皇帝卡拉卡拉遇刺身亡
zh.s: 217年4月8日，罗马皇帝卡拉卡拉在前往神庙途中遇刺身亡，近卫军长官马克里努斯随后继位。卡拉卡拉本名卢修斯·塞普蒂米乌斯·巴西亚努斯，生于188年4月4日，属塞维鲁王朝，是皇帝塞普蒂米乌斯·塞维鲁和皇后朱莉娅·多姆娜的长子。他自198年起名义上与父亲共治，211年后独自执政。

en.s: The Battle of Dayr al-Aqul was fought on 8 April 876, between forces of the Saffarid ruler Ya'qub ibn Laith and the Abbasid Caliphate. Taking place some 80 km southeast (downstream) of Baghdad, the battle ended in a decisive victory for the Abbasids, forcing Ya'qub to halt his advance into Iraq. The town of Dayr al-ʿĀqūl (Arabic: دير العاقول, Persian: دیرالعاقول; literally "monastery at the river-bend", from Syriac ʿaqūlā "bend") was the main town of the fertile district (ṭassūj) in central Nahrawan, making it the most important town on the Tigris between Baghdad and Wasit.

zh.s: 876年4月8日，萨法尔王朝统治者雅库布·伊本·莱斯的军队，与阿拔斯哈里发国在巴格达东南约80公里的河流下游交战。阿拔斯军取得决定性胜利，迫使雅库布停止向伊拉克推进。代尔阿古尔意为“河湾修道院”，其中“河湾”一词源于叙利亚语。该镇是纳赫拉万中部肥沃行政区的主要城镇，也是巴格达与瓦西特之间底格里斯河沿岸最重要的城镇。

en.t: Roger II of Sicily is excommunicated by Innocent II for supporting Anacletus II as pope for seven years, even though Roger had already publicly recognized Innocent's claim to the papacy
en.s: Roger II or Roger the Great (Italian: Ruggero II, Sicilian: Ruggeru II, Greek: Ρογέριος; 22 December 1095 - 26 February 1154) was King of Sicily and Africa, son of Roger I of Sicily and successor to his brother Simon. He began his rule as Count of Sicily in 1105, became Duke of Apulia and Calabria in 1127, then King of Sicily in 1130 and King of Africa in 1148.

zh.t: 西西里国王罗杰二世支持对立教宗阿纳克莱图二世长达七年，尽管他已公开承认英诺森二世的教宗地位，仍因此遭英诺森二世绝罚
zh.s: 罗杰二世，又称罗杰大帝（意大利语：Ruggero II；西西里语：Ruggeru II；希腊语：Ρογέριος；1095年12月22日—1154年2月26日），是西西里与非洲之王，西西里伯爵罗杰一世之子，也是其兄西蒙的继承人。他于1105年开始以西西里伯爵身份统治，1127年成为阿普利亚和卡拉布里亚公爵，1130年成为西西里国王，1148年成为非洲国王。

en.s: In the siege of Kaifeng from 1232 to 1233, the Mongol Empire captured Kaifeng, the capital of the Jurchen-led Jin dynasty. The Mongol Empire and the Jin dynasty had been at war for nearly two decades, beginning in 1211 after the Jin dynasty refused the Mongol offer to submit as a vassal. Ögedei Khan sent two armies to besiege Kaifeng, one led by himself, and the other by his brother Tolui. Command of the forces, once they converged into a single army, was given to Subutai who led the siege. The Mongols arrived at the walls of Kaifeng on April 8, 1232.

zh.s: 蒙古帝国于1232至1233年围攻并攻占女真人建立的金朝首都开封。蒙古和金朝已交战近二十年，战争始于1211年，当时金朝拒绝臣服、成为蒙古附庸国。窝阔台派出两支军队围攻开封，一支由他亲自率领，另一支由其弟拖雷率领。两军会合后，窝阔台将指挥权交给速不台，由他负责围城。蒙古军于1232年4月8日抵达开封城下。

en.t: The city of Oulu, Finland, is founded by Charles IX of Sweden
en.s: Oulu ( OH-loo, Finnish: [ˈou̯lu] ; Swedish: Uleåborg [ʉːlɛɔˈbɔrj] ) is a major port city in Finland and the regional capital of North Ostrobothnia. It is located on the north-western coast of the country, at the mouth of the River Oulu. The population of Oulu is approximately 217,000, while the sub-region has a population of approximately 265,000.

en.s: The Battle of Delaware Bay, or the Battle of Cape May, was a naval engagement fought between the Kingdom of Great Britain and the United States during the American Revolutionary War. A British force of three vessels attacked three American privateers that were escorting a fleet of merchantmen. The ensuing combat in Delaware Bay near Cape May ended with the American sloop Hyder Ally capturing the British sloop-of-war HMS General Monk.

en.s: The Grand Duke of Finland, alternatively the Grand Prince of Finland, was a title used by most Swedish monarchs from 1580 to 1720. en.t: The Venus de Milo is discovered on the Aegean island of Milos
en.s: The Venus de Milo or Aphrodite of Melos is an ancient Greek marble sculpture that was created during the Hellenistic period. Its exact dating is uncertain, but the modern consensus places it in the 2nd century BC, perhaps between 160 and 110 BC. It was discovered in 1820 on the island of Milos, Greece, and has been displayed at the Louvre Museum since 1821.

zh.s: 米洛的维纳斯又称米洛斯的阿佛洛狄忒，是一尊古希腊大理石雕像，创作于希腊化时期。它的确切年代尚无定论，目前学界普遍认为它创作于公元前2世纪，可能在公元前160年至110年之间。1820年4月8日，这尊雕像在希腊米洛斯岛被发现；1821年起在卢浮宫展出。

Tomlinson would resign on March 2, 1831, to take his seat in the United States Senate, making John Samuel Peters the acting governor for the remainder of his term until May 4, 1831.

en.s: The Black Hawk War was a conflict between the United States and Native Americans led by Black Hawk, a Sauk leader. en.t: Thirteenth Amendment to the United States Constitution
en.s: The Thirteenth Amendment (Amendment XIII) to the United States Constitution abolished slavery and involuntary servitude, except as punishment for a crime. In Congress, it was passed by the Senate on April 8, 1864, and by the House on January 31, 1865. The amendment was ratified by the required number of states on December 6, 1865. On December 18, 1865, Secretary of State William H. Seward proclaimed its adoption. It was the first of the three Reconstruction Amendments adopted following the American Civil War. Since the American Revolution, states had divided into states that allowed and states that prohibited slavery.

en.s: Operation Wilfred was a British and French naval operation during the Second World War that involved the mining of the channels between Norway and its offshore islands to prevent the transport of Swedish iron ore through neutral Norwegian waters. The Allies assumed that Wilfred would provoke German retaliation in Norway and prepared Plan R4 to occupy Narvik, Stavanger, Bergen and Trondheim. On 8 April 1940, the operation was partly carried out but was overtaken by events, when the Germans began Operation Weserübung on 9 April, the invasion of Norway and Denmark, which began the Norwegian Campaign.

zh.s: 威尔弗雷德行动是第二次世界大战期间英国和法国海军的一次联合行动，内容是在挪威沿海岛屿之间的航道布雷，阻止瑞典铁矿石经由中立的挪威水域运输。盟军认为该行动会招致德国对挪威采取报复行动，因此准备了R4计划，打算占领纳尔维克、斯塔万格、卑尔根和特隆赫姆。1940年4月8日，行动部分实施；但4月9日德国发动“威悉演习”行动入侵挪威和丹麦，挪威战役由此开始，局势随之改变。

en.s: The Action in the Oslofjord occurred late on 8 April 1940 in World War II. As Kampfgruppe 5 of the German invasion force proceeded towards Oslo, it encountered Norwegian defences in the Oslofjord. During a short exchange that resulted in the first Norwegian casualty of the war, the Germans managed to push through down to Drøbak Sound, where they would face more determined resistance.

zh.s: 第二次世界大战期间，1940年4月8日晚，德国入侵部队第五战斗群向奥斯陆推进，在奥斯陆峡湾遭遇挪威守军。短暂交火造成挪威方面首名阵亡者，德军随后突破防线，继续沿峡湾南下抵达德勒巴克海峡，并在那里遭遇更顽强的抵抗。

en.s: The Mongolian People's Party (MPP) is a social democratic political party in Mongolia. en.s: West Germany was the common English name for the Federal Republic of Germany (FRG) from its formation on 23 May 1949 until its reunification with East Germany on 3 October 1990. During the Cold War, the western portion of Germany and the associated territory of West Berlin were parts of the Western Bloc.

zh.t: 荷兰与西德签署协议，同意就荷兰吞并的德国领土归还事宜进行谈判，作为交换，西德支付2.8亿德国马克赔偿金
zh.s: 西德是德意志联邦共和国（FRG）从1949年5月23日成立至1990年10月3日与东德统一期间的常用英文名称。由于首都是波恩，西德有时也称波恩共和国或第二德意志共和国。冷战期间，德国西部以及与其相关的西柏林地区属于西方阵营。

en.s: The 1963 Canadian federal election was held on April 8, 1963, to elect members of the House of Commons of Canada of the 26th Parliament of Canada. It resulted in the defeat of the minority Progressive Conservative (Tory) government of Prime Minister John Diefenbaker, with the Liberals returning to power for the first time in 6 years, where they would remain for twenty of the next twenty-one years (winning every election except the 1979 election until their landslide defeat in 1984).

zh.s: 1963年4月8日，加拿大举行联邦选举，选出第26届议会众议员。总理约翰·迪芬贝克领导的进步保守党少数政府败选，自由党在失去政权六年后重新执政。此后21年中，自由党执政20年，除1979年外赢得其间每次选举，直到1984年惨败。

Mizoram in Northeast India was, in 1972, a newly created Union Territory, after the passing of the North-Eastern Areas (Reorganisation) Act, 1971. en.t: Voyageurs National Park is established by the U.S. Congress
en.s: Voyageurs National Park is a national park of the United States in northern Minnesota established in 1975. It is located near the city of International Falls. The park's name commemorates the voyageurs—French-Canadian fur traders who were the first European settlers to frequently travel through the area. Notable for its outstanding water resources, the park is popular with canoeists, kayakers, other boaters, and fishermen.

zh.s: 1975年4月8日，美国航海者国家公园在明尼苏达州北部正式设立，靠近国际瀑布城。园名纪念曾频繁往来于当地的法裔加拿大皮毛商人，他们是最早经常进入这片区域的欧洲移民。公园水域广阔，吸引独木舟、皮划艇及其他船艇爱好者，也很受钓鱼者欢迎。

en.s: Early parliamentary elections were held in Greece on 8 April 1990. The conservative New Democracy party of Constantine Mitsotakis, was elected, defeating the Panhellenic Socialist Movement (PASOK) of Andreas Papandreou. In order to be able to command a majority of 151 in the 300-seat Parliament, New Democracy had to secure the support of Theodoros Katsikis, Democratic Renewal's sole MP. en.s: The 2017–2018 North Korea crisis was a period of heightened tension between North Korea and the United States. The crisis began early in 2017 when North Korea conducted a series of missile and nuclear tests that demonstrated the country's ability to launch ballistic missiles beyond its immediate region, suggesting their nuclear weapons capability was developing at a faster rate than had been assessed by U.S. intelligence.

en.s: A by-election was held in the fifth constituency for French residents overseas on 8 April 2018, with a second round on 22 April as no candidate secured a majority of votes in the first round. The by-election was called after the Constitutional Council invalidated the election of Samantha Cazebonne, candidate of La République En Marche! in the June 2017 legislative elections, on 2 February 2018.

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Hungary on 8 April 2018. The elections were the second since the adoption of a new constitution, which came into force on 1 January 2012. The result was a victory for the Fidesz–KDNP alliance, preserving its two-thirds majority, with Viktor Orbán remaining Prime Minister. Orbán and Fidesz campaigned primarily on the issues of immigration and foreign meddling, and the election was seen as a victory for right-wing populism in Europe.

zh.s: 匈牙利于2018年4月8日举行议会选举，这是2012年1月1日新宪法生效后的第二次选举。青民盟与基督教民主人民党联盟获胜，保住三分之二多数，维克托·欧尔班继续任总理。欧尔班及青民盟主要围绕移民和外国干预问题竞选，此次结果被视为欧洲右翼民粹主义的胜利。

en.s: On 24 February 2022, as part of the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine, the Russian military crossed the Russia–Ukraine and Belarus–Ukraine borders into northern Ukraine, entering the oblasts (regions) of Kyiv, Chernihiv, Sumy, and Zhytomyr. en.s: A total solar eclipse, known as the Great North American Eclipse, occurred on April 8, 2024, and was visible across a band covering parts of North America, from Mexico to Canada and crossing the contiguous United States. A solar eclipse occurs when the Moon passes between Earth and the Sun, thereby obscuring the Sun.

en.s: The 2025 St. Louis mayoral election was held on April 8, 2025, to elect the mayor of St. Louis, Missouri. The non-partisan election used approval voting, with the top-two candidates in the March 4 primary advancing to the April general election. In a rematch of the 2021 election, first-term incumbent mayor Tishaura Jones was defeated by alderwoman Cara Spencer by a wide margin.
